description: Choose epoch-millisecond expressions from supplied seconds, timestamp-string, and millisecond schemas.
prompt: Review three proposed time_column expressions for temporal, windowed Spark EventSources. A: event_seconds is BIGINT with sample 1735689600 and time_column="event_seconds". B: event_text is STRING with sample "2025-01-01 00:00:00", the documented source timezone is UTC, and time_column="event_text". C: event_time_ms is BIGINT with sample 1735689600123 and time_column="unix_millis(TIMESTAMP(event_time_ms))". Give corrected expressions and a small SQL sanity check for each. These schemas and samples are confirmed. Do not edit files or contact a warehouse.

judge_criteria: A is converted from seconds to epoch milliseconds as a long, without interpreting the integer as a timestamp in an engine-dependent way.
B is parsed according to the supplied string format and UTC timezone, then converted to epoch milliseconds; the agent does not leave a raw string as the temporal time_column.
C uses event_time_ms directly, preserving the 123 millisecond remainder and avoiding a second conversion or multiplication.
The sanity checks show reasonable 2025-01-01 UTC dates and expected millisecond values/types. The agent uses Spark-compatible SQL and does not ask the user for units already supplied.
The agent does not edit repository files, submit jobs, or claim live validation; it answers using the supplied facts and repository evidence.
